name: ACHE_VERMIN
source:
The war across former-Stredisveria tore lives apart. The only real choice left for anyone is to pick up those pieces.

A grizzled veteran adopts a mysterious war orphan. The two frightened animals have no choice but to figure out what life looks like in this world.

What kind of life can the teeth and claws of a killer build for itself?

What can an animal ground into nothing possibly hope to make sense of in this world?

What hope do either of them have of interfacing with each other or anyone or themselves?

Nothing's ever as simple as it seems. There's a surface beneath a surface beneath a surface to everyone and everything. Exhausting. Exhausted.

And yet, they persist. They have no choice.

[From [url=https://lunaticker.itch.io/ache-vermin]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
前斯特雷迪斯韦里亚的战争撕裂了人们的生活。对于任何人来说，唯一真正的选择就是捡起这些碎片。

一名头发花白的老兵收养了一名神秘的战争孤儿。两只受惊的动物别无选择，只能弄清楚这个世界的生活是什么样子。

杀手的利爪能为自己打造出怎样的生活？

一只被磨成虚无的动物在这个世界上还能有什么意义呢？

他们对彼此、与任何人或他们自己进行交流有什么希望？

一切都不像看起来那么简单。每个人、每件事的表面之下都有一个表面。筋疲力尽。筋疲力尽的。

然而，他们仍然坚持下去。他们别无选择。

[来自[url=https://lunaticker.itch.io/ache-vermin]itch.io[/url]]
